query:
SELECT 
  DATE(createdAt) as data,
  COUNT(*) as total_vendas,
  SUM(finalAmount) as total_valor
FROM sales 
WHERE YEAR(createdAt) = 2025 AND (MONTH(createdAt) = 11 OR MONTH(createdAt) = 12)
GROUP BY DATE(createdAt)
ORDER BY createdAt DESC;
